abstract: On the morning of 6 February 2024, SMPTE introduced the Power of Color Symposium (POC) to the world. This event showcased the intersection of art and science, new technologies in the realm of color science, and the importance of accurate representation in film and television. Over two days, those at the forefront of color science gave powerful, dynamic presentations that challenged established media experts and inspired future leaders.
